CustomField.description: When true and Collapsible__c is also true, the section auto-collapses to its summary card once its completeness predicate evaluates true. Leave false for sections whose expanded content matters even when complete (e.g. Communication Preferences with its consent text).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Auto-collapse this section to its summary when complete. Only takes effect if Collapsible__c is true.
CustomField.label: Auto Collapse When Complete
